verdict.rationale: mParticle documents several APIs that cover parts of the platform beyond event ingestion: a Platform API section for Audiences, a Warehouse Sync API, and IDSync. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full API parity with the UI, and some documented flows, such as connecting an audience to an output via Data Platform > Setup > Directory, are described only as UI steps. missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/UI parity, API coverage of connection and output setup, data planning and quality, and privacy/consent settings, and independent or hands-on confirmation that UI actions can be done through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: with a Warehouse Sync API, SQL reference, and data mapping
